component.name: Redragon Control
component.summary: Saved lighting for Redragon K686 MAX keyboards

description.p: Control your Redragon K686 MAX keyboard with native desktop settings, saved lighting effects and reusable profiles.

Includes a one-time hardware setup helper. Keyboard access is limited to explicit lighting saves; closing the window quits the app. Requires a Linux desktop and udev device permissions. Independent software, not affiliated with Redragon.
Save onboard lighting only. Remove input remapping, tray and login startup; close the window to quit. Disable legacy startup and stop old workers.

Move distribution from Flatpak to AppImage. Add login startup for GNOME, KDE Plasma and Omarchy, a Launch at login toggle, and embedded GitHub update information for Gear Lever. Publish matching update and checksum files.

Fix daemon control between AppImage mounts, keep the tray alive for explicit GUI launches, recover malformed appearance settings, and prevent closing Settings during an active operation. Retire Flatpak distribution.
Add an AppImage with bundled GTK and Python and an Enable keyboard access button with administrator authentication on the first setup page.
Add automatic Omarchy appearance with an Adwaita override. Save lighting on the keyboard without continuous RGB traffic and improve input remapping.
Show the one-time hardware permission command during Flatpak setup and allow manual startup on desktops without a Background portal.
Show the keyboard selector above the lighting preview and display the preview only on the Lighting page. Update desktop wording for Linux, including KDE Plasma.
Preserve unsaved lighting and wheel edits during unrelated actions, synchronize the color picker with typed colors, and retain wheel bindings added during setup.
Fix the Flatpak tray icon appearing as three dots by using the exported app icon and a host-visible icon lookup path.
